notes: Official tuned-lens defaults (SGD Nesterov, momentum 0.9, lr = lr_scale*(1-momentum), weight decay 1e-3, no warmup, linear decay, grad clip 1.0, KL(final||lens)), with a project token budget: the paper's 2**18 tokens/step x 250 steps (~65M token-steps) exceeds this ~0.2M-token corpus, so 2**14 tokens/step x 250 steps (~4M token-steps, ~20 epochs). Best validation-KL checkpoint, evaluated every 25 steps. Pilot uses pilot_steps and is exploratory.
